name: cache-warmer
description: Show this Codex session's prompt cache status, whether keeping it warm while you are away costs less than a cold resume, and keep it warm until you return.

interface.shortDescription: Keep your prompt cache warm while you are away
interface.longDescription: Tell Cache Warmer how long you will be away. It prices keeping this session's prompt cache warm against a cold resume, from the session's own token usage and the model's prices, and keeps the cache warm only when that is cheaper. A summary on your return and a dashboard show what each run cost and saved. It reads token counts and timestamps, never message text.
